phrase: a Sneaker Storage and Care Brand
verdict: Yes, for the sneaker community. Snea Kare from Delhi pitched sneaker storage crates and care kits on Shark Tank India Season 1 and got a deal. Sneaker collectors spend on storage and care, and the community is loyal.
angle: Sneaker collectors want to protect expensive shoes. Storage crates, cleaning kits and protectors sell online. Sneaker events and creators are strong channels.
